mutants.description: the loader no longer restricts technology slugs (a slug can read outside knowledge/technologies)
INTERNALLY_CERTIFIED is TRUE for a role that is only TESTED (certTrue = certified || tested)
the CERTIFIED-claim-exceeds-evidence anomaly is not raised
per-row withCandidateSkills counts every role of the group
per-row withCandidateToolAdapters counts roles with candidate SKILLS instead of candidate adapters
the result is always labelled AUTHORITATIVE, even with a non-default promoted technology set
the certificate expiry is checked against the real clock (Date.now()) instead of the injected now
RUNNING reports a measured 0 for any journal value other than exactly ABSENT (undefined / unknown value)
an empty group (denominator 0) is reported as measured
the loader accepts an empty roles/guilds/clusters/skills array
duplicate guild / binding / proposed-profile keys are first-wins again (the digest depends on array order)
duplicate guilds are last-wins
duplicate bindings are last-wins
duplicate proposed profiles are last-wins
a PRESENT journal without a runs array is read as a measurement
a non-default promoted technology set is not disclosed in inputs
legacy-referenced skills are counted as PROFILED (C-RDY-2b M1)
a registry knowledgeState of SEED_PROFILE is counted as source-backed (C-RDY-2b M2)
PROFILED reads the PROPOSED skills of the role context as canonical (C-RDY-2b M3)
the competency-pack ontology split is never flagged
an unsupplied runtime consumer count is reported as a structural 0
a CERTIFIED claim on a skill is read as INTERNALLY_CERTIFIED TRUE
a duplicated skill id is still DEFINED
a malformed skill id is still DEFINED
non-executable entity layers are FALSE instead of NOT_APPLICABLE
the entity audits are always labelled AUTHORITATIVE and never disclose the promoted set
technology KNOWLEDGE_READY follows source-backed instead of a researched, validated, sourced unit
technology PROFILED ignores the promoted status (any requiring role is enough)
the entity loader accepts an empty competency-packs array
a runs array makes the journal PRESENT regardless of its tag (H1)
